q: The story is so ______ that all the children like listening to it.
explain: interesting 表示事物本身有趣，常作表语或定语修饰事物；interested 表示人对某事感兴趣，主语通常是人，是易混项。

q: I hope ______ you again next year.
explain: hope 后接不定式作宾语，即 hope to do sth，表示希望做某事。hope 不能接 doing，也不能接 sb to do，seeing 是易错项。

q: He finished ______ his homework before supper.
explain: finish 后接动名词，finish doing sth 表示做完某事，是固定搭配。finish 不接不定式，这是常考点。

q: Not only the students but also the teacher ______ the film very much.
explain: not only...but also 连接两个主语时谓语遵循就近原则，与靠近的 the teacher 保持一致，用单数 likes。

q: 句子「I want to buy a dictionary this Sunday.」语法正确。
explain: want 后接不定式作宾语，want to do sth 用法正确，句子时态和结构也没有问题。

q: Mom told me ______ too much time playing computer games.
explain: tell sb not to do sth 表示让某人不要做某事，不定式的否定式是把 not 放在 to 前面，不能写成 to not spend。

q: He got up early ______ the first bus.
explain: 不定式作目的状语，表示起床早的目的是赶上头班车。catching 作状语多表示伴随，不表目的。

q: Would you mind ______ the door? It's cold outside.
explain: mind 后接动名词，mind doing sth 表示介意做某事，是固定句型。

q: 句子「He suggested to go there by train.」语法正确。
explain: suggest 后接动名词，即 suggest doing sth，或接宾语从句 suggest that sb should do，不能接不定式，应改为 suggested going。

q: It is necessary ______ a foreign language well.
explain: It is 加形容词加 to do 句型中，it 是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式 to learn。

q: The headmaster, together with the teachers, ______ in the meeting room now.
explain: 主语后接 together with 短语时谓语遵循就远原则，与前面的 the headmaster 保持一致；now 提示现在时，用 is。

q: ______ from space, the earth looks like a blue ball.
explain: 地球是被看的对象，分词作状语与主语 the earth 是被动关系，用过去分词 Seen。Seeing 表主动，是易错项。

q: My little brother enjoys ______ stories before bedtime.
explain: enjoy 后接动名词，enjoy doing sth 表示喜欢做某事，enjoy 不接不定式。

q: 句子「The teacher, together with his students, are having a meeting now.」语法正确。
explain: together with 连接的成分不作主语看待，谓语遵循就远原则，应与 the teacher 一致用 is，即 is having a meeting。

q: The room is clean and tidy ______ a few books on the floor.
explain: except for 表示整体肯定、局部除外，房间整体整洁，只是地板上有几本书。except 表示同类排除，besides 表示除了……还有。

q: They decided ______ a trip to Beijing during the holiday.
explain: decide 后接不定式，decide to do sth 表示决定做某事。

q: There ______ some milk and some eggs in the fridge.
explain: there be 句型遵循就近原则，靠近 be 的 some milk 是不可数名词，用 is。易被后面的 eggs 误导。

q: Either you or he ______ to clean the classroom today.
explain: either...or 连接主语时谓语遵循就近原则，与 he 一致；be to do 表示按计划要做的事，故用 is。

q: 句子「She is good at dancing and singing.」语法正确。
explain: 介词 at 后接动名词作宾语，be good at doing sth 表示擅长做某事，dancing 和 singing 并列正确。

q: Everybody ______ here today. Let's begin the meeting.
explain: everybody、everyone 等不定代词作主语时谓语用单数，故用 is。

q: Do you have any difficulty ______ English grammar?
explain: have difficulty doing sth 是固定句型，表示做某事有困难，difficulty 后接动名词。

q: The teacher asked us ______ careful with our homework.
explain: ask sb to do sth 表示要求某人做某事，不定式作宾语补足语。

q: His family ______ a very big one.
explain: family 指家庭这个整体时作单数看待，谓语用 is；只有强调家庭成员时才用复数。

q: 句子「There are a pen and two books on the desk.」语法正确。
explain: there be 句型遵循就近原则，靠近 be 的是 a pen，应用 is，即 There is a pen and two books on the desk。

q: ______ the letter, she went out to post it.
explain: 写完信发生在出去寄信之前，分词动作先于谓语动作完成，用现在分词的完成式 Having finished 作状语。

q: Everyone passed the exam ______ Li Ming, who was ill that day.
explain: except 表示把同类的人或物排除在外，李明没通过考试，被排除。besides 表示除了……之外还有，与句意相反。

q: It's very kind ______ you to show me the way.
explain: 形容词 kind 说明人的品质时，句型是 It is 加形容词加 of sb to do；说明事情对某人的意义时才用 for sb to do。

q: The post office is ______ the bank and the hotel.
explain: between...and...表示在两者之间，是固定搭配。among 用于三者或三者以上之中。

q: I haven't heard from him ______.
explain: 否定句句末表示还用 yet；already 用于肯定句，still 表示仍然，多放在句中。

q: 句子「It took me an hour to finish my homework yesterday.」语法正确。
explain: It takes sb some time to do sth 是固定句型，it 作形式主语，不定式是真正主语；yesterday 提示过去时 took，用法正确。

q: The meeting began half an hour ______.
explain: 一段时间加 ago 表示多久以前，与一般过去时连用。before 单独使用多与完成时连用。

q: Though he lives ______, he has many friends.
explain: alone 作副词表示独自地，修饰 lives；lonely 是形容词，强调内心孤独，不能修饰动词。

q: ______ it will rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella with you.
explain: maybe 是副词，表示也许，可放在句首；may be 是情态动词加 be 动词，只能作谓语，不能放句首单独使用。

q: — I won first prize in the speech contest! — ______
explain: 听到别人获奖的好消息应表示祝贺，用 Congratulations。Good luck 用于事先祝愿，What a pity 用于遗憾的事。

q: 句子「I look forward to hear from you soon.」语法正确。
explain: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词，应改为 look forward to hearing from you，这是高频易错点。

q: We think ______ our duty to keep the classroom clean.
explain: it 作形式宾语，真正的宾语是后面的不定式 to keep the classroom clean，our duty 是宾语补足语。

q: The boy kept ______ at the bus stop for an hour.
explain: keep 后接动名词，keep doing sth 表示一直做某事。

q: This museum is well worth ______ a second time.
explain: be worth doing sth 表示值得做某事，动名词用主动形式表被动意义，不接不定式。

q: The cup ______ by Tom yesterday was very expensive.
explain: 杯子是被打碎的，过去分词 broken 作定语表被动和完成；breaking 表主动，broke 是谓语形式不能作定语。

q: 句子「Neither he nor I am interested in maths.」语法正确。
explain: neither...nor 连接主语时谓语遵循就近原则，靠近谓语的是 I，故用 am，句子正确。

q: I advise him ______ up smoking as soon as possible.
explain: advise sb to do sth 表示建议某人做某事；注意 advise 后面没有宾语时才接 doing，即 advise doing sth。

q: Each of the students ______ a new dictionary.
explain: each of 加复数名词作主语时，谓语动词用单数，故用 has。易被 students 误导选 have。

q: — Would you like to go shopping with me this afternoon? — ______
explain: 对 Would you like to 的邀请作肯定回答用 Yes, I'd love to，其中 to 不能省略。

q: We are busy ______ for the coming final exam.
explain: be busy doing sth 是固定句型，表示忙于做某事，接动名词 preparing。

q: 「眼见为实」译为「Seeing is believing.」，翻译恰当。
explain: 两个动名词分别作主语和表语，结构对称，符合英语谚语 Seeing is believing 的表达习惯。

q: I want you ______ me with my English after class.
explain: want sb to do sth 表示想要某人做某事，不定式作宾语补足语。

q: Neither the twins nor their father ______ football on weekends.
explain: neither...nor 连接主语时谓语遵循就近原则，与 their father 保持一致，用单数 likes。

q: 句子「Everyone in our class like English very much.」语法正确。
explain: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数，应改为 likes，即 Everyone in our class likes English very much。

q: 「被邀请参加晚会，他很高兴」译为「He is very glad to invite to the party.」，翻译恰当。
explain: 他是被邀请的，不定式应用被动式 to be invited，即 He is very glad to be invited to the party。

q: 「对我们来说，每天锻炼很重要」译为「It is very important for us to exercise every day.」，翻译恰当。
explain: 句型 It is 加形容词加 for sb to do 使用正确，it 作形式主语，for us 引出不定式的逻辑主语。
